components.name: Pizza Sauce
instructions: Heat oil and sauté vegetables and meats over moderate heat until onions are straw-coloured[cite: 79, 82, 95].
Add tomato purée, tomato sauce, water, cheese, bay leaf, pepper, salt, and oregano[cite: 95, 96, 99, 101, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107].
Cover and simmer slowly 45 minutes[cite: 108].
Uncover and continue to simmer slowly 45 minutes[cite: 108].

components.name: Pizza Dough
instructions: Combine Bulgor and 1-3/4 cups water. Cover and bring to simmer. Simmer 15 minutes or until most of liquid is absorbed. [cite_start]Cool to lukewarm[cite: 109, 110, 148].
Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup lukewarm water[cite: 151, 152, 153, 154].
Sift together flour and salt[cite: 149, 155, 156].
Stir in cooked Bulgor and yeast mixture to the flour[cite: 159].
Add oil and mix thoroughly until dough leaves sides of bowl[cite: 157, 159].
Lightly oil surface of dough, cover and let rise in warm place (about 85°F) until doubled in volume, about 1-1/2 hours[cite: 160].
Divide dough in half. [cite_start]Roll each half into circle to fit 12-inch pizza pan[cite: 161, 166].
Brush surface lightly with oil. [cite_start]Let rise in warm place about 20 minutes[cite: 161, 166].

components.name: Assembly
instructions: Arrange slices of mozzarella cheese on surface of pizza crust[cite: 163, 167].
Top with layer of sauce[cite: 163].
Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese[cite: 163, 168].
Bake in moderately hot oven, 375°F, 35 to 40 minutes[cite: 164, 169].

name: Persian Pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh tomatoes or canned tomatoes [cite: 115, 116, 117]
instructions: Have butcher cut shoulder of lamb into inch cubes. [cite_start]Braise well in pot[cite: 121].
Add chopped onions and brown lightly with the meat. [cite_start]Add tomatoes and cook for 15 minutes[cite: 122].
Meanwhile put Bulgor in boiling broth and cook for 7 minutes[cite: 123].
Drain and put over top of meat in the pot[cite: 124].
In centre of Bulgor, place the butter[cite: 124].
Pour 1 cup of broth around the edges of the meat[cite: 125].
Bake in a moderate oven for about one hour[cite: 125].
Turn onto platter and serve unmixed and very hot[cite: 126].

name: India Lamb Pilaf
ingredients: 3 cups cooked lamb cut in cubes [cite: 130]
instructions: Heat oil in heavy skillet. [cite_start]Add cooked lamb, onion, tart apple, and garlic[cite: 145].
Sauté over moderate heat until meat and onions are lightly browned[cite: 146].
Blend in the rest of ingredients[cite: 146].
Cover and bring to boil. [cite_start]Reduce heat and simmer slowly until thickened, about 40 minutes[cite: 147].

name: India Chicken Curry Pilaf
ingredients: 1 medium-sized tart apple, peeled, cored and chopped [cite: 176, 177, 178]
instructions: Heat butter or fat in heavy skillet. [cite_start]Add onion, apple, and celery[cite: 171, 175, 176, 179].
Sauté over moderate heat until onions are straw-coloured[cite: 172, 180].
Blend in curry powder, ginger, flour, salt, and pepper[cite: 172, 181, 182, 183, 184, 185].
Remove from heat and stir in chicken stock and cream or milk[cite: 173, 186, 187].
Return to heat and stir constantly until mixture thickens and comes to a boil[cite: 188, 189].
Add cooked diced chicken and Bulgor[cite: 189, 190].
Cover and simmer over low heat 25 minutes[cite: 191].
